name: Birth Of Jesus
overview: The birth of Jesus is a divine fulfillment of prophecy, marked by a virgin conceiving and bearing a son called Immanuel, meaning 'God with us' (Isaiah 7:14). This child, born in Bethlehem as foretold by Micah, is the promised ruler whose origins are eternal (Micah 5:2). Matthew’s Gospel confirms that Jesus’ birth was miraculous, conceived by the Holy Spirit, and His name, meaning 'Saviour,' reveals His purpose to save His people from their sins (Matthew 1:18, 21). The arrival of wise men at His birth underscores His significance as the prophesied Wonderful Counselor and Prince of Peace (Isaiah 9:6; Matthew 2:1).
